name: "Freezer Friendly" Italian Beef & Pork Sausage Meatballs (Batch-Cooking)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe makes about 64 meatballs or eight (8 meatball) servings.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Coat two large baking sheet pans with oil.
Peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry herbs. Shave parsley leaves off the stems, then pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place herbs in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the herbs.

When the onion and garlic are cool, transfer to the bowl along with beef, pork sausage, eggs, bread crumbs, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the mixture into meatballs and divide between the baking sheets.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g lean ground beef
454 g ground pork sausage
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
2 tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and bake, turning once, until meatballs are golden and cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven, and allow to cool completely, about 30 minutes.

STORING: Place cooled meatballs on clean, parchment-lined baking sheets, keeping meatballs separated, and freeze for 4 hours. Once frozen, divide meatballs between containers or resealable plastic bags, removing as much air as possible. Return to the freezer and store for up to 2 months.



HEATING: For best results, thaw meatballs in the fridge overnight. Bake in a preheated 400°F oven until heated through, 12-15 minutes. If baking from frozen, increase baking time to 15-20 minutes. Frozen meatballs can also be added to simmering sauces, soups, and stews, cooking until heated through.
